{
  "participants": [

      "login": "sedited",
      "stance": "question",
      "note": "asked whether the wizard belongs in the repository or should be an external script"
    },
    {
      "login": "BenWestgate",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK and Tested ACK; tested offline multisig setup, argued repo inclusion protects users, raised review nits on timestamp handling and backups"

    {
      "login": "kevkevinpal",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected to merging the script due to the maintenance burden of keeping it in the repo when it will become obsolete"
    },
    {
      "login": "pseudoramdom",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "leaning Concept NACK due to review/maintenance overhead of temporary workarounds and risk of users trusting contrib with real funds"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:5828804605",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "keep the wizard as an external script rather than adding it to the repository",
      "quote": "Do we need this in the repository? Seems fine to me if it were just an external script.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "the author explained the intent as a CLI counterpart to the GUI wizard; BenWestgate argued repo inclusion counters scammers pushing less-reviewed alternatives",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5844636792"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "r:5359830788"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5844636792",
      "status_by_quote": "Aside from being a demonstration of the multisig setup flow, the utility is intended to become a command-line equivalent"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5971349539",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "adding the script introduces an ongoing maintenance burden for maintainers for a tool that will be obsolete once GUI/wallet work is done",
      "quote": "It is just another piece of code the Bitcoin Core maintainers will need to worry about forever.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author committed to maintaining the script until RPCs obsolete it; BenWestgate argued it serves as a functional checklist",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6002949265"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:5985919355"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6002949265",
      "status_by_quote": "Yes. I'll maintain it, we have enough test cases to force a maintenance contract on whoever modifies code touching it."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5985919355",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "whether the author is willing to maintain the script, including bug fixes, until RPCs obsolete it",
      "quote": "are you willing to maintain this script (including bug fixing) until the RPC obsoletes it?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author confirmed they will maintain the script",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6002949265"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6002949265",
      "status_by_quote": "Yes. I'll maintain it, we have enough test cases to force a maintenance contract on whoever modifies code touching it."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6373344413",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "reviewing and maintaining temporary workarounds that will be superseded by core wallet changes diverts resources from implementing the backend items",
      "quote": "Merging this would mean reviewing ~700 lines (script and functional test) whose job is to work around things we plan to fix. We'd then have to review again each time one of those fixes lands and remov",

    },

      "part": 2,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "placing the script in contrib/ makes it look like a recommended tool, risking user funds and proving difficult to undo",
      "quote": "Also putting a script in `contrib/` makes it look like a recommended tool and that's hard to undo once people use it with real funds.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6374070423",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "reduce the script size as much as possible (e.g. 100-300 lines) to minimize review time and encourage review",
      "quote": "What's the absolute smallest it could be made to maximize the number of people willing to review it and minimize the time it takes them?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6374070423",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "modularize the script so each workaround can be deleted and replaced with a new RPC as it lands",
      "quote": "Could you modularize it so that each time one of our workarounds lands, we just delete a function or module and replace it with the new RPC?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6488924478",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "using \"now\" as the timestamp in import_descriptor sets the wallet birth time to genesis on an offline node, causing backup restoration on a pruned node to fail",
      "quote": "In `importdescriptors`, \"now\" means the best block's time. An offline node has only the genesis block, so the wallet's birth time is genesis. Restoring that wallet's backup on a pruned online node then fails with `Prune: last wallet synchronisation goes beyond pruned data. You need to -reindex`.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6488924478",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "document the requirement to back up both the key wallet and the descriptor after import_descriptor",
      "quote": "After `import_descriptor`, each participant has to back up their key wallet and the descriptor. A key wallet alone can't rebuild the multisig. The wizard's docstrings don't mention this. It may belong in the README rather than the code.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],

    {
      "id": "r:5359830788",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Core having user unfriendly multisig has been exploited by scammers to promote alternative multisig wallets with substantially less scrutiny than this repository",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []

    {
      "id": "c:6488924478",
      "verdict": "Tested ACK",
      "reason": "ran all wizard steps on an offline node for 2-of-3 wsh(sortedmulti), created PSBT on restored online watch-only coordinator, signed offline, and verified acceptance via testmempoolaccept",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "both",
      "areas": [
        "import_descriptor"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Added BenWestgate's Tested ACK and two new items from c:6488924478 regarding timestamp handling on offline nodes and documenting the backup requirement.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "respond to pseudoramdom's Concept NACK concerns regarding maintenance and safety in contrib/",

    },
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "address BenWestgate's suggestions and review findings on timestamp handling and backup docs",
      "id": "c:6488924478"
    }
  ]
